news.title: Man Utd next manager: World Cup winner's stance on replacing Michael Carrick revealed amid shock links
news.lede: Manchester United have explored the possibility of appointing Didier Deschamps should they decide to part ways with Michael Carrick. However, the 2018 World Cup winner is said to have reservations about taking charge at Old Trafford given the club's current predicament. With Carrick under increasing pressure, Red Devils chiefs may need to turn their attention elsewhere in their search for a new manager. Deschamps, who stepped down as France manager following the 2026 World Cup, is currently out of work and understood to be open to returning to club management, having previously managed AS Monaco, Juventus and Marseille.

news.title: More than three months after the World Cup, why haven't the Socceroos been paid?
news.lede: Just days after it was revealed that both male and female national team players were taking legal action against Football Australia (FA) over their revenue-sharing agreement, members of the 2026 Socceroos World Cup squad are pursuing Australia's football governing body for match payments. Payment was due within a fortnight of the date they broke camp. Australia were knocked out of the tournament at the round-of-32 stage in a loss to Egypt on 3 July. FA, which recorded a $23 million loss over the last two financial years, said tax complications in the United States caused the delay.

news.title: Game in limbo, World Cup fees unpaid as Socceroos crises emerge
news.lede: A squad announcement for the upcoming international window has been delayed for the Socceroos as players continue to raise concerns about travelling to the Middle East due to conflict in the area. Australia is scheduled to face Qatar and Jordan at their respective home grounds next week, with pressure mounting on the organisers to find an alternative venue for their match against Jordan due to concerns about player safety. Vinicius jnr, Tete Yengi and Nestory Irankunda talk after the match. Tony Popovic, who comes off contract in January, was set to unveil his team for the looming friendlies on Friday but the announcement has been moved to the weekend, according to The Sydney Morning Herald.

news.title: Men's World Cup: Mexico's most creative football pitches
news.lede: On the southern outskirts of Mexico City, amateur teams meet on a very unique football pitch every Sunday. Known as the "Field of the Gods," it is perched inside the extinct Teoca volcano and situated a breathtaking 2,700 meters (8,800 feet) above sea level. The pitch was created by the nearby community more than 60 years ago and is a source of local pride. Cars above, sports below: this pitch in Mexico City's colorful Las Aguilas neighborhood gives people the space to play soccer beneath a highway overpass.

news.title: Socceroos still waiting for World Cup payment from FA
news.lede: Socceroos players are awaiting payment from this year's FIFA World Cup. (Reuters: Kai Pfaffenbach). Players from the Socceroos who participated in this year's FIFA World Cup are yet to be paid their fees. Payment was supposed to be made within a fortnight of the team leaving camp, following their round-of-32 loss to Egypt.

news.title: Man United make contact with World Cup-winning manager but face unexpected setback – report
news.lede: Manchester United have made contact with former France manager Didier Deschamps as the club continues to explore managerial options amid growing uncertainty surrounding Michael Carrick’s future. That is according to a report from French outlet Foot Mercato, which claims that Manchester United board leaders have reached out to Deschamps in recent days to see if he is interested in taking over at Old Trafford. The Red Devils’ hierarchy is actively sounding out elite profiles to stabilise the club during a chaotic Premier League campaign. The report adds that while United have also made approaches to Germany boss Julian Nagelsmann and Aston Villa’s Unai Emery, who appears set to sign an extension with the club, Deschamps has emerged as a big name target.
